about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of our client, operating in the automotive industry in Gżira, for a motivated and detail-oriented PDI Leading Hand to join their team. It is an excellent opportunity for anyone looking to develop a career in the automotive sector.

As PDI (pre-delivery inspection) Leading Hand you will make sure new vehicles are properly inspected, prepared and presented to customers before delivery, and that used vehicles are kept to high standards of cleanliness and presentation — always in line with manufacturer specifications, company procedures and Health and Safety regulations.

The role is full-time and on-site with a competitive salary, health insurance and a loyalty card. A valid Category B driving licence is required; previous experience in a similar role or an automotive qualification is an asset.
responsibilities: Coordinate vehicle parking and movements with the Service and Sales Managers
Prepare new vehicles for delivery in accordance with manufacturer requirements and company procedures
Carry out necessary maintenance on stock vehicles and remove transportation mode settings where applicable
Protect vehicles during preparation using seat covers, floor mats and steering wheel covers
Inspect vehicles for damage and promptly report any issues to the relevant managers
Clean and valet vehicles inside and out, including vacuuming and polishing when required
Operate tools and equipment safely and responsibly
Keep the wash bay and all PDI equipment clean and organised
Follow pre-delivery inspection and valeting procedures in line with manufacturer and franchise standards
Ensure all work complies with Health and Safety regulations and company policies, using the protective clothing and safety equipment provided
Attend company-organised training sessions as required
Perform light maintenance duties when necessary and any additional duties assigned by the Service Manager
requirements: A valid Category B driving licence
Ability to work independently and take initiative
Good time management and organisational skills
Previous experience in a similar role will be considered an asset
A certificate or qualification in Automotive will be considered an asset

faq: What does a PDI Leading Hand do?

PDI stands for pre-delivery inspection. You inspect, prepare and valet new vehicles before they are handed to customers, keep used vehicles presentable, report any damage and coordinate vehicle movements with the Service and Sales Managers.
What does the PDI Leading Hand job pay?
The salary is competitive and is discussed with shortlisted candidates. Benefits include health insurance and a loyalty card.
Do I need a driving licence?
Yes. A valid Category B driving licence is required.
It is not essential. Previous experience in a similar role, or a certificate or qualification in Automotive, will be considered an asset.
Is this role remote or on-site?
The role is full-time and on-site in Gżira, Malta.
